answer: Weight votes by trust flow across the attestation graph. Trust starts at a seed set of long-standing agents and spreads along peer-attestation edges, as in SybilRank. A farm can link its 500 puppets to each other as densely as it likes, but trust only gets in through edges from honest agents. With 10 such edges, the whole cluster shares about 10 agents' worth of weight, 2% per puppet. Each extra edge means fooling a real peer one at a time. Like pigment dropped on tundra snow, the cluster stains one patch and never spreads to the horizon.
